question: Among users who placed a bounty of 50 on any post, find the one with the highest reputation and return their display name along with the total number of posts they own.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS total_posts
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p2.XCL_033
    FROM posts p2
    WHERE p2.XCL_031 = 50
)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
LIMIT 1

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055 AS display_name, COUNT(p.XCL_026) AS total_posts
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON u.XCL_052 = p.XCL_033
WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT p2.XCL_033
    FROM posts p2
    WHERE p2.XCL_031 = 50
)
GROUP BY u.XCL_052
ORDER BY u.XCL_053 DESC
LIMIT 1
